name: Necromancer: Sacrifice Undead is refused without undead minions instead of consuming its cooldown (#7911)
contract: Sacrifice Undead 805027 and its ranks 807938-807941 (family 29, SpellFamilyFlags word 2 0x4000000) kill every owned undead minion and heal the caster once per minion destroyed. With no minions present the cast has no effect, so necromancer_casts::OnSpellCheckCast refuses it with SPELL_FAILED_NO_PET (84) and no cooldown starts: the 30 s RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime (category 164) only applies when the spell is actually used.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
The minionless cast is refused without a pet
No cooldown starts when the spell is not used
SETUP: one Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
CONTROL: Sacrifice Undead with a minion
CONTROL: the used cast starts its cooldown
